title: Review Event
description: One line of the append-only NDJSON review journal for contract: review-journal/v0. A single finding, verdict, remediation, or gate event emitted by a review seat. Every entry carries its own data classification so a record's sensitivity ceiling is enforceable per the ROE (see docs/standards/fierce-collaboration-review.md).

round.description: Review round. Findings persist across rounds until proven closed.

seat.description: The role seat emitting the event. Core seats have contract semantics; x- seats are adopter-specific.

agent.description: The reviewing agent's execution context — the axis panel-variance analysis compares over.

phase.description: What kind of event this is.

finding_id.description: Stable, seat-namespaced finding identity, reused across rounds and never for a different defect. Recommended shape <SEAT>-<SCOPE>-R<round>-<n> (e.g. DR-CVG-S3-R6-1). Strongly recommended when phase is finding/verdict/remediation.

target.description: What the event is about — a file:line or an artifact.

severity.description: Finding severity. A P1 is a blocker until green on re-review.

evidence.description: The proof carried with the claim. Absence of evidence is not permission to synthesize it.

verdict.description: Reviewer's verified conclusion — not an accepted fix report.

remediation_ref.description: Pointer to the remediation (PR/commit/test) offered by the implementing side.

anchor.description: Immutable provenance anchor. Where the branch is subject to rewrite (e.g. squash-before-finalize) or unpushed, prefer a content digest over a commit SHA, since the SHA does not survive the rewrite: 'sha256:<hex>' of one artifact's bytes, or 'git-tree:<object-format>:<oid>' covering a multi-artifact reviewed set (e.g. 'git-tree:sha1:2d3e...'). The object format is read from the repository rather than assumed, so the label names the algorithm that produced the value. A message ID anchors a live exchange.
